# Headless prose implementation and proof

Owner request, 2026-10-24: prove prose/HITLMAN honestly with real API calls,
session goals and reusable document types before implementing further UI.
Authority: [0045](../intent/decisions/0045-prove-session-governed-prose-headlessly-before-ui.md).
Specification: [HP](../designs/prose-headless-proof.md), including HP-A01..18.
Existing AE-10/11 and PH/HW/PX remain open until their own wider exits pass.

This is the active reference in the existing second incubation. The command
program remains active but further expansion waits. No third slot or installation.
The parent owns acceptance/oracles, live study and integration. The isolated Claude
lane owns prose-kit code and `scenarios/prose-headless/`. No shared-file editing.

Before claiming a plan row:

```sh
fathom verify --service agentic-kit --plan docs/plans/prose-headless-proof.md
```

Use strict verification at integration, and retain separate actual tests/provider
receipts. Never use existing symbol reachability to claim the new behavior is proven.

under its original word-range gate. All required facts were cited in86 words, and
eight configured model support checks passed, but goals remain unassessed. The

boundary finding, not HP-A14 or UI entry. HP-10 is a prospective policy change,
not permission to relabel or retry this cell.

The source and command units passed full local validation. The actual four-target
